objective: Fix the audited reliability issues and reorganize Social Composer around templates, canvas, and an inspector with a matte black theme.
delivery: One verified, reviewable stage at a time, as requested by the user.

acceptance: Failed storage writes leave stored and visible libraries unchanged
A thirteenth save never deletes an earlier design
Storage-budget failures preserve all saved work
Failed removals retain the saved design and can be retried
Existing save/restore, text, cover and export tests pass

additional_checks: Browser smoke with all storage reads and writes blocked

acceptance: Delayed uploads, restores and template renders cannot replace newer canvas actions
Transparent and partially transparent backgrounds survive save, reload and PNG export
AURA artwork stays 1080x1920 while Lumen can stage its next format
Oversized graphemes and visible text overhang block PNG export until corrected
Selecting, moving and resizing preserves saved overlay order
Existing eight browser suites remain green

additional_checks: All 1572516 alpha values preserved through large-image WebP save, restore and PNG export
Small transparent PNG and SVG exact RGBA
Independent code review and font-gated restore/fallback probes
Real-font Tamil, emoji and serif-overhang checks
verification.storage_note: Transparent backgrounds stay lossless PNG when the complete entry fits; oversized entries may use high-quality WebP color compression with exact alpha. Existing library limits and no-eviction rules remain in place.

scope: Accessible mixed layer controls and geometry
Project backup and template source persistence
Matte black theme and consolidated UI tokens
Mobile Edit/Preview workflow and reachable actions
Sibling library controls and touch targets
Pinned development tooling and one test command
